title: Zoe header
description: A navy announcement strip with one yellow link over a clean white 72px bar: a chunky yellow wordmark, plain navy links (the first opens a small product menu on hover) and a hairline Login button that fills navy on hover. Both stay pinned to the top while the page scrolls; on phones a menu button drops a full-height white panel.
notes: the strip and bar are position: sticky together, so put the block first, directly in the page
links turn the ring colour (violet in the zoe theme) on hover
name: zoe-header
